thread.title: Apple Stock Could Face 'Sell The News' Reaction To Quarterly Report

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Stock Could Face 'Sell The News' Reaction To Quarterly Report
text:
With expectations for Apple 's ( AAPL ) fiscal second-quarter largely baked into the company's shares, the iPhone maker's stock faces a "sell the news" reaction when it posts results on May 1, a Wall Street analyst said Monday.
X Raymond James analyst Chris Caso raised the caution flag for Apple stock in a note to clients Monday. He reiterated his market perform rating on shares.
Apple shares gained 0.6% to close at 175.82 on the stock market today . Apple stock notched a record high of 183.50 on March 13. It has built a flat base with a buy point of 183.60.
"We think there's a high likelihood of a 'sell the news' reaction to the cash return details to be discussed on the upcoming call," Caso said in a note to clients. Apple stock also could be pressured by expectations for weak iPhone sales in the June quarter and sales "mix uncertainty for the fall iPhone lineup," he said.

Analysts expect a big boost to share buybacks and dividends thanks to U.S. corporate tax reforms signed by President Donald Trump.
Dividend Hike Seen On Friday, Longbow Research said Apple could double its dividend to align its payout ratio with that of its large-cap technology peers, CNBC reported .
Caso lowered his estimates for Apple's June quarter after meeting with the company's Asian supply chain partners. He now expects Apple to sell 41 million iPhones in the quarter, vs. consensus expectations for 43 million units.
"Longer term, we think Apple is struggling with the rising cost of adding new features, necessitating higher iPhone prices," he said. "As such, we think second-half 2018 and 2019 estimates will be highly dependent on the success of the new iPhone X Plus; but the response to iPhone X doesn't leave us encouraged."
Apple is widely expected to introduce three new iPhones in September. They include an updated version of the current 5.8-inch organic light-emitting diode, or OLED screen iPhone X and a 6.5-inch OLED screen iPhone X Plus. Apple also is rumored to be coming out with a 6.1-inch liquid crystal display screen smartphone, possibly called the iPhone 9.
